purpose: Pipeline sanity check only. These are published immune-state signals, not discovery candidates.
source: Sade-Feldman et al., Cell 2018 / GEO GSE120575; memory-like CD8/T-cell markers are associated with response and dysfunctional/exhausted states with non-response in the source study.
analysis_limit: Scores are composition-sensitive because the source matrix contains all CD45+ cells. Results do not establish a cell-intrinsic effect or a causal mechanism.
